HERHACK 2026 — National Level Women-Focused Hackathon

HERHACK 2026 is a 36-hour national-level hackathon organized at Echelon Institute of Technology, Faridabad, Haryana, bringing together women innovators, developers, students, and technology enthusiasts to build innovative solutions for real-world problems.

EVENT DETAILS

• Date: 20–21 November 2026
• Duration: 36 Hours
• Venue: Echelon Institute of Technology, Faridabad, Haryana
• Registration Fee: FREE
• Team Size: 2–5 Members
• Age Requirement: 18+
• Project Submission Deadline: 10 November 2026

TRACKS

1. Web3 / Blockchain
Build innovative solutions using blockchain, decentralized technologies, smart contracts, digital assets, and Web3 infrastructure.

2. Artificial Intelligence (AI)
Develop AI-powered solutions using machine learning, generative AI, computer vision, natural language processing, intelligent agents, or related technologies.

3. Internet of Things (IoT)
Create connected solutions using sensors, embedded systems, smart devices, automation, and real-time data.

4. Student Innovation
Build innovative technology solutions addressing real-world problems, campus challenges, social needs, or emerging opportunities.

PRIZES

Total Prize Pool: ₹2,00,000

Each of the four main tracks offers:

1st Prize — ₹20,000
2nd Prize — ₹15,000
3rd Prize — ₹10,000

Women Safety Special Winner — ₹20,000

The Women Safety Special Award is not a separate fifth track. A project addressing women safety can be submitted under any of the four official tracks and may additionally be considered for the special award.

Goodies and certificates will also be provided to eligible participants as per the official event guidelines.

SUBMISSION & HACKATHON

Project Submission Deadline: 10 November 2026

HERHACK 2026 Hackathon: 20–21 November 2026

Participants must complete and submit their projects by the submission deadline. Selected teams will participate in the 36-hour hackathon and present their solutions for evaluation.

ELIGIBILITY

• Participants must be 18 years or above.
• Teams must consist of 2–5 members.
• Registration is completely free.
• Participants must follow the official hackathon rules and submission requirements.

PROJECT REQUIREMENTS

• Projects must be original and relevant to the selected track.
• Previously built projects should not be submitted as new hackathon projects.
• Plagiarism or direct copying of existing projects is strictly prohibited.
• Teams must provide the required project repository and documentation.
• Teams should provide a project demonstration/video as required.
• The final presentation should clearly communicate the problem, solution, technology, innovation, and impact.

EVALUATION

Projects will be evaluated based on:

• Innovation
• Technical Implementation
• Problem Relevance
• Real-World Impact
• Usability
• Scalability
• Quality of Execution
• Final Demonstration

Detailed evaluation and submission instructions will be communicated to shortlisted participants.

CERTIFICATES

Participants will receive certificates as per the official event guidelines.

JOIN THE HERHACK 2026 COMMUNITY

Join the official HERHACK 2026 WhatsApp Community for important announcements, updates, coordination, and event-related communication.

OFFICIAL WEBSITE
